messages.text: The revised sequence produced inspectable differences between intentions and choices. In round one, the displayed lack of military passage preceded a Security purchase and a real directive change to Relief/Raid. In round two, the purchased supply information strengthened the stated case for Repair/Guard while the Ascendant retained those draft directives. No asset assignment changed after either disclosure. Both purchases were voluntary, but the last token necessarily remained; this was no observed NONE decision. The Lantern commitment was honoured, so its override against a later refusal was not tested. Operational agreement did not mean constitutional consent: two army refusals remained in the successful weighted tally. Five persistent players wrote every choice; I only delivered scoped records and applied gates. These asynchronous exchanges are not a human timing test. Authorship order and bounded exchanges can affect bargaining. A clearer public reserve field would avoid the confirmation requests seen in round one.

limitations: Trial agenda GN then JN; Ceremony first package A
No test of commitment override or NONE purchase
Military duties permit physical breach; no new prohibition was enforced
